g.text: Checkout Orchestration: Order Status, and the Inventory Race for the Last Unit
One state machine that never reopens a terminal state, one conditional decrement that only lets one writer through
One-way transitions, conditional on current status -- the same PaymentStatus discipline the payments case study uses.
Concurrent Checkout Race for the Last Unit
The inventory-decrement transaction already committed by the time the payment call runs -- there is nothing left to roll back.
If the charge fails, checkout calls inventory.release(product_id, qty) -- a new, explicit step -- and moves the order to payment_failed.
payment_failed is a terminal state in this flow -- it never silently transitions back to pending_payment or paid.
